title: Rabbit and Dog
summary: Rabbit and Dog are good friends who love doing lots of things together. Let's see what they do today.
pages: Rabbit and Dog are good friends.
Rabbit and Dog play happily together.
Rabbit sings a song for Dog.
Rabbit plays the khaen and Dog dances. *A khaen is a mouth organ made of bamboo. This instrument comes from Laos, and people love it all over Southeast Asia.
Dog plays the guitar for Rabbit.
Rabbit and Dog pick fruit and eat.
Rabbit and Dog pick lots of fruit.
Rabbit and Dog rest and take a little nap.
